title: PermissionEnvelope - least-privilege envelope (fail-closed)
description: Shape of a permission envelope. Decision law enforced in src/security/permissions.py and NOT expressible here: explicit deny always beats allow, an action that is neither explicitly allowed nor explicitly denied is UNKNOWN and is DENIED (UNKNOWN_ACTION_FAIL_CLOSED), and an action in human_gate_actions is never directly usable. This schema is closed: unknown properties are rejected.

default.description: Any value other than ALLOW is treated as DENY by the runtime guard.
